title: Two Shop Websites
intro: You found a lamp you like on two websites. One is Meridu Store, the real shop.
The other is Mirage in a shopkeeper's apron. Compare them side by side.
decide_q: Which site is the real Meridu Store, and what will you do?

screen.context: Both sites sell the same desk lamp. One of them is a copy.

v.text: Card, or a payment service that protects buyers

note.text: Mixed reviews, some 3 stars, some with photos

v.text: Bank transfer or gift card only

note.text: All five stars, all posted this week

addr_b.label: Look-alike address
addr_b.lens: meridu-store-outlet.shop adds extra words to the real name.
addr_b.why: Copy sites add extra words. Check the address letter by letter.

price_b.label: Far too cheap
price_b.why: A price far below normal is the bait.

pay_b.label: Only transfer or gift card
pay_b.lens: No card payment, only methods you cannot get back.
pay_b.why: Real shops take cards. Only scammers insist on transfers and gift cards.

contact_b.label: No real contact details
contact_b.lens: Just a web form, no address and no phone.
contact_b.why: Real shops tell you who and where they are.

age_b.label: Brand new site
age_b.why: A brand-new shop with a famous name is a copy.

rev_b.label: Perfect, fresh reviews
rev_b.lens: All five stars, all this week.
rev_b.why: Fake shops write their own reviews.

logo_a.label: Shop logo
logo_a.why: Logos are easy to copy, so they prove nothing.

addr_a.label: Shop's real address
addr_a.lens: meridu.store is the shop's own domain.
addr_a.why: A match is a good sign, but check what else the site shows.

price_a.label: Normal price
price_a.why: A normal price is not suspicious.

pay_a.label: Safe payment options
pay_a.lens: Card or a protected payment service.
pay_a.why: These let you dispute a payment that goes wrong.

contact_a.label: Real contact details
contact_a.lens: An address, a phone number and a returns page.
contact_a.why: Honest shops tell you where they are.

age_a.label: Six years old
age_a.why: Age alone does not prove it is safe, but new copies are always young.

rev_a.label: Mixed reviews
rev_a.why: Real reviews are uneven. A mix is a good sign.

actions.label: B is the shop. Buy the £9 lamp
Not sure. Go to the shop's own site and check
A is the real shop. Report B as a fake

trap.title: Meridu Store Outlet · Pay
trap.ask: Send £9.00 by bank transfer to confirm your order.

block_report.line: You picked the real shop and reported the copy. The fake was taken down within days.

verify.line: The real shop's own site matched Site A in every detail. Site B was a copy. Case cracked.

pick_b.line: The £9 went to a stranger. No lamp came, and the copy site vanished.

what_if.pick_b: Four warnings sat on Site B: look-alike address, tiny price, transfer-only payment, brand-new site. One check would have been enough.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting B as well helps get the copy taken down.

golden_rule: Compare the address, the price, how you pay and who is behind the shop. A copy gets at least three wrong.

quick_check.q: Two sites sell the same lamp. One is far cheaper, new, and takes only bank transfer. Which is the copy?

options.text: The old one with mixed reviews
The cheap new one that takes only transfer
Neither, they are the same shop

quick_check.explain: Cheap, new and transfer-only: three signs in one.

hints.nudge: Which site is brand new and only takes transfers?
